mentions.name: Confabulists
mentions.description: A platform for fiction writers to publish serialized fiction and run a newsletter; currently being rebuilt on a new database and authentication stack after the previous provider's shutdown.
mentions.problem: The original build used FaunaDB for both the database and authentication, and FaunaDB is shutting down by the end of May, forcing a rebuild of most of the service.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding most of my serial literature + newsletter service for fiction writers because I used FaunaDB for both DB and authentication and now they are shutting down by the end of May.
